name: Circus Poster
description: A bold harlequin diamond lattice in crimson, gold, cream and teal against deep indigo, built from a single flipped triangle.

code.style: --rule: ( clip-path: polygon(50% 100%, 0 0, 100% 0); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); @row(even) { transform: scale(1, -1); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; gap: 0; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
